description: Submit the authenticated worker's weekly timesheet for a native WEEKLY-review contract. Provider-backed FINAL_ONLY contracts do not use this workflow; they settle into one final contract statement after offboarding. Requires time:write scope and the public API time-tracking feature.

contractId.description: Contract whose week is being submitted.

weekStart.description: Any UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) inside the week; normalized to its UTC Monday.

name: opentrain_time_timesheet_submit
